description: A bearded man in a gold laurel wreath and gilded armour under a deep red cloak raises one hand toward a crowd in a city street. Behind him rises a large, partly scaffolded stone amphitheatre with arches, and scaffolding and a smoking brazier stand nearby. Soldiers in plumed helmets and togas-wearing onlookers fill the scene, under an overcast sky. No visible text, border or frame; the painting is edge to edge.
